title: Utegymsindex 2026: outdoor gyms per 10,000 residents in Sweden's 290 municipalities
description:
Outdoor gyms and lit exercise tracks per 10,000 residents for every Swedish municipality, with rank, checked on 23 November 2026. Counts come from the municipality's own list where one exists (43 municipalities); otherwise the highest of Naturkartan, OpenStreetMap (points at one place merged into one site) and named outdoor gyms on municipal, tourism or news pages, marked as a minimum with a confidence level and sources per municipality. Population from Statistics Sweden (SCB, 2025).

Method, charts and the full ranking: amblecoach.com/sv/data/utegymsindex.
